artists_traditions_valid.name: artists_traditions_valid
artists_traditions_valid.value: cardinality("artists"."traditions") BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND array_ndims("artists"."traditions") = 1 AND array_position("artists"."traditions", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("artists"."traditions", chr(31)) !~ ('(^|' || chr(31) || ')[[:space:]]*(' || chr(31) || '|$)')

artists_public_links_valid.name: artists_public_links_valid
artists_public_links_valid.value: cardinality("artists"."public_links") <= 10 AND coalesce(array_ndims("artists"."public_links"), 1) = 1 AND array_position("artists"."public_links", NULL) IS NULL AND (cardinality("artists"."public_links") = 0 OR array_to_string("artists"."public_links", chr(31)) ~ ('^https?://[^[:space:]' || chr(31) || ']+(' || chr(31) || 'https?://[^[:space:]' || chr(31) || ']+)*$'))

artists_manual_verification_complete.name: artists_manual_verification_complete
artists_manual_verification_complete.value: ("artists"."verification_status" = 'UNVERIFIED' AND "artists"."verified_by_wallet" IS NULL AND "artists"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("artists"."verification_status" = 'VERIFIED' AND "artists"."verified_by_wallet" IS NOT NULL AND "artists"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

artists_timestamp_order.name: artists_timestamp_order
artists_timestamp_order.value: "artists"."updated_at" >= "artists"."created_at" AND ("artists"."verified_at" IS NULL OR "artists"."verified_at" BETWEEN "artists"."created_at" AND "artists"."updated_at")

artwork_media_mime_kind_valid.name: artwork_media_mime_kind_valid
artwork_media_mime_kind_valid.value: ("artwork_media"."kind" = 'IMAGE' AND "artwork_media"."mime_type" IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/avif')) OR ("artwork_media"."kind" = 'VIDEO' AND "artwork_media"."mime_type" IN ('video/mp4', 'video/webm')) OR ("artwork_media"."kind" = 'DOCUMENT' AND "artwork_media"."mime_type" = 'application/pdf')

artwork_media_alt_text_valid.name: artwork_media_alt_text_valid
artwork_media_alt_text_valid.value: ("artwork_media"."alt_text" IS NULL OR "artwork_media"."alt_text" ~ '[^[:space:]]') AND ("artwork_media"."visibility" <> 'PUBLIC' OR "artwork_media"."kind" <> 'IMAGE' OR "artwork_media"."alt_text" IS NOT NULL)

metadata_versions_document_integrity.name: metadata_versions_document_integrity
metadata_versions_document_integrity.value:
("artwork_metadata_versions"."canonical_document" IS NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."document_hash" IS NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT') OR
      ("artwork_metadata_versions"."canonical_document" IS NOT NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."document_hash" IS NOT NULL
       AND octet_length(convert_to("artwork_metadata_versions"."canonical_document", 'UTF8')) BETWEEN 2 AND 1048576
       AND jsonb_typeof("artwork_metadata_versions"."canonical_document"::jsonb) = 'object'
       AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."document_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
       AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."document_hash" = encode(sha256(convert_to("artwork_metadata_versions"."canonical_document", 'UTF8')), 'hex'))

metadata_versions_receipt_complete.name: metadata_versions_receipt_complete
metadata_versions_receipt_complete.value:
("artwork_metadata_versions"."status" <> 'FINALIZED' AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_cluster" IS NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_signature" IS NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_slot" IS NULL
       AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_recorded_at" IS NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR
      ("artwork_metadata_versions"."status" = 'FINALIZED' AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_cluster" IS NOT NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_signature" IS NOT NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_slot" IS NOT NULL
       AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL
       AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_signature" ~ '^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{64,88}$'
       AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_slot" >= 0 AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."finalized_at" >= "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_recorded_at")

metadata_versions_chain_version_valid.name: metadata_versions_chain_version_valid
metadata_versions_chain_version_valid.value: ("artwork_metadata_versions"."status" <> 'FINALIZED' AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_version" IS NULL) OR ("artwork_metadata_versions"."status" = 'FINALIZED' AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_version" IS NOT NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."chain_version" BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295)

metadata_versions_uri_valid.name: metadata_versions_uri_valid
metadata_versions_uri_valid.value:
("artwork_metadata_versions"."uri" IS NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT') OR
      ("artwork_metadata_versions"."uri" IS NOT NULL AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."uri" ~ '^https?://[^[:space:]@/#?]+([/?][^[:space:]#]*)?$'
       AND octet_length("artwork_metadata_versions"."uri") <= 200 AND "artwork_metadata_versions"."uri" !~ '[^ -~]')

artworks_dimensions_valid.name: artworks_dimensions_valid
artworks_dimensions_valid.value: ("artworks"."height_mm" IS NULL AND "artworks"."width_mm" IS NULL AND "artworks"."depth_mm" IS NULL) OR ("artworks"."height_mm" IS NOT NULL AND "artworks"."width_mm" IS NOT NULL AND "artworks"."height_mm" > 0 AND "artworks"."width_mm" > 0 AND ("artworks"."depth_mm" IS NULL OR "artworks"."depth_mm" > 0))

blockchain_operations_hashes_valid.name: blockchain_operations_hashes_valid
blockchain_operations_hashes_valid.value: cardinality("blockchain_operations"."expected_hashes") BETWEEN 0 AND 32 AND (cardinality("blockchain_operations"."expected_hashes") = 0 OR (array_ndims("blockchain_operations"."expected_hashes") = 1 AND array_position("blockchain_operations"."expected_hashes", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("blockchain_operations"."expected_hashes", ',') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}(,[0-9a-f]{64})*$'))

    AND array_to_string("fulfillment_requests"."address_lines", chr(31)) !~ ('(^|' || chr(31) || ')[[:space:]]*(' || chr(31) || '|$)')
